svg.text: Backlog 85: the card's tabs are the domains, Cost first then Capacity. Overview is gone. Example numbers. The tab in use is the undimmed one.
A. Capacity's icon: four candidates (wide row: emoji and word; narrow: emoji alone). Cost keeps 💰.
